stem.zh-CN: 在 [[term:quantization|INT8 量化]]部署中，以下哪些因素会影响量化后模型的精度？
stem.en-US: Which factors affect model accuracy after [[term:quantization|INT8 quantization]] deployment?

explanation.zh-CN: [[term:calibration-set|校准集]]分布影响量化参数标定；激活统计不稳定导致[[term:quantization-scale|scale]]偏差；[[term:outlier|离群值]]拉大scale降低精度。浮点训练是前提而非量化精度影响因素。
explanation.en-US: The distribution of the [[term:calibration-set|calibration set]] affects quantization-parameter calibration; unstable activation statistics can bias the [[term:quantization-scale|scale]]; and [[term:outlier|outliers]] can enlarge the scale and reduce accuracy. Floating-point training is a prerequisite, not a direct factor affecting post-quantization accuracy.

primaryConcept.en-US: Calibration factors affecting INT8 quantization accuracy

text.zh-CN: [[term:calibration-set|校准集]]分布是否接近真实数据
text.en-US: Whether the [[term:calibration-set|calibration-set]] distribution is close to real data

text.zh-CN: 是否存在[[term:outlier|离群值]]导致 [[term:quantization-scale|scale]] 不合理
是否使用了浮点数进行训练
text.en-US: Whether floating-point numbers were used for training
